title: Feasibility of large language models for CEUS LI-RADS categorization of small liver nodules in patients at risk for hepatocellular carcinoma

live_model.evidence: "the reports were input into ChatGPT-4o mini (14), ChatGPT-4o (15), ChatGPT-4.0 (16) and Google Gemini (17) for prompt CEUS LI-RADS classification" (Materials and methods)

prompt.location: Materials and methods (structured-report-to-chatbot workflow described); exact wording of what was typed into the chat window is not printed
prompt.note: Three output rounds per case with a majority vote; no system prompt or API parameters given.

claim.metric: Sensitivity for small HCC diagnosis (junior-level radiology reports)
claim.location: Results table, row GPT-4o, first column "70 (61/87)"

data.source: Institutional CEUS exam reports and images from West China Hospital of Sichuan University (retrospective, IRB-approved); not a public dataset

notes: No API, temperature, or token parameters are mentioned anywhere; 'chatbot' framing and manual entry of translated structured reports indicate the ChatGPT web interface. Undated 'ChatGPT-4o' with data access through December 2024 (per alias_note) falls after the 2024-10-02 cutoff, so it is unresolved rather than gpt-4o-2024-05-13. Patient CEUS reports are institutional and not public.
